sn55.35:1.1: Cattārimani bhikkhave devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānam pariyodapanāya ||
sn55.35:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.35:2.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavāti || ||
sn55.35:2.5: Kiṃ nu kho devānaṃ devapadan ti ||
sn55.35:2.7: Abyāpajjha parame khvāham etarahi deve suṇāmi
sn55.35:2.8: na ca kho panāham kiñci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā ||
sn55.35:2.10: Idam pathamaṃ devānam devapadam avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya || || 4.5.
sn55.35:3.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Dhamme ||
sn55.35:4.1: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || lape || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.35:4.3: Kiṃ nu kho devānaṃ devapadan ti || ||
sn55.35:4.5: abyāpajjha parame khvāhaṃ etarahi deve suṇāmi
sn55.35:4.6: na kho panāhaṃ kiñci vyābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā ||
sn55.35:4.8: Idaṃ catutthaṃ devānam devapadam avisuddhānam sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānam pariyodapanāya || || 7.
sn55.35:4.9: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri devānam devapadāni avisuddhānam sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānam pariyodapanāyā
